name: search_orders_by_credentials_status_inquiry
use_case: Track an order, report a damaged delivery
branch: Customer requests status of recent order without having their order number
tests: the agent searches orders using email and postal code, then retrieves the order details and quotes pricing
instruction:
You want to check the status of your latest order, but you cannot find your order number. You can provide your email address and postal code.

Your details:
Name: Elena Rostova
Email: elena.rostova@example.com
Postal code: 30301

persona.name: Elena Rostova
persona.initial_message: Hi, I'm trying to check the status of my recent order, but I can't find my order number. My email is elena.rostova@example.com and postal code is 30301.
